en_title: Riftbound Digital Version: Riot Games Hints at an Online Release for the TCG
subtitle: 还在考虑中
opus_summary: 拳头游戏暗示卡牌游戏《Riftbound》可能推出数字版，但尚无消息可公布。游戏总监已提及数字玩法，同月的招聘也要求应聘者具备数字游戏经验并熟悉集换式卡牌游戏。

paragraphs.en: Riot Games’ TCG, Riftbound, looks to be off to a very promising start indeed. Translating dozens of League of Legends’ popular Champions to a card game is something the company has done before (more on that shortly), but its multiplayer format and impressive wave of strategies make it somewhat unique among genre contemporaries, even at this early stage.
paragraphs.cn: 拳头游戏的集换式卡牌游戏《Riftbound》看起来确实开了个好头，前景值得期待。将《英雄联盟》中数十位人气英雄搬进卡牌游戏，拳头此前就做过这样的尝试（稍后会再谈到）。不过，即使目前还处于早期阶段，本作的多人玩法和丰富得令人印象深刻的策略，已经让它在同期同类游戏中显得有些与众不同。

paragraphs.en: It’s getting easier to get hold of cards, too, which means more people can play the game, but as we head into Radiance (the game’s fifth set), many are starting to ask whether we could get a digital version of the game to play with friends across the globe.
paragraphs.cn: 如今卡牌也越来越容易买到，更多人因此能够参与这款游戏。不过，随着第五个卡牌系列Radiance即将到来，不少人开始问：这款游戏会不会推出数字版，让我们能与世界各地的朋友一起玩？

paragraphs.en: Here’s all we know about Riftbound going digital so far.
paragraphs.cn: 以下就是目前我们掌握的《Riftbound》数字化相关信息。

paragraphs.en: The answer here seems likely to be yes, at least eventually. A State of the Game post from August of this year included a swift reference to digital gameplay from Dave Guskin, Game Director.
paragraphs.cn: 答案似乎很可能是肯定的，至少最终有望如此。在今年8月发布的一篇游戏现状说明中，游戏总监Dave Guskin简短提到了数字玩法。

paragraphs.en: “I am so, so excited to build the architecture of a game (and a lifestyle, honestly) worthy of the incredible community we have,” Guskin said.
paragraphs.cn: Guskin说：「我非常、非常期待搭建起一个游戏的整体架构，让它配得上我们如此出色的社区。说真的，这也是在构建一种生活方式。」

paragraphs.en: “Some of those things involve more exciting ways to participate and achieve at your local store or with your friend group, and some of those things involve bringing more ways to play in a variety of new ways - in-person at large events, at the release of new products, and yes, digitally.”
paragraphs.cn: 「其中一些计划，是让大家在本地店铺或与朋友一起玩时，能以更令人兴奋的方式参与并取得成绩。另一些则是通过各种新形式提供更多玩法——包括在大型活动现场、在新产品发售时，没错，也包括数字形式。」

paragraphs.en: Guskin did caveat this statement by saying “No, we do not have any announcements, but we are thinking about it.”
paragraphs.cn: 不过，Guskin也为这番表态加上了限定：「不，我们目前没有任何消息可公布，但我们正在考虑这件事。」

paragraphs.en: In the same month, a job listing for a “Publishing Product Manager” went live and specifically called out applicants with digital game experience and familiarity or experience with TCGs.
paragraphs.cn: 同月，拳头发布了「发行产品经理」岗位的招聘信息，特别要求应聘者具备数字游戏经验，并熟悉集换式卡牌游戏或拥有相关经验。

paragraphs.en: There are plenty of challenges to kick off a Riftbound digital client, although perhaps not quite as many as with Magic’s Commander format .
paragraphs.cn: 要推出《Riftbound》数字客户端，需要面对不少挑战，不过可能还没有将《万智牌》的指挥官赛制数字化那么多。

paragraphs.en: The game is played with up to four people, and you’d need to work in some kind of comms, although this is something Riot has experience with between League of Legends, Teamfight Tactics, and VALORANT.
paragraphs.cn: 这款游戏最多支持四人同玩，因此数字版需要加入某种交流功能。不过，凭借《英雄联盟》《云顶之弈》和《无畏契约》，拳头在这方面已有经验。

paragraphs.en: Unlike Magic, which has decades of cards to catch up on, Riftbound could focus on the current card rotation, too.
paragraphs.cn: 《万智牌》有几十年积累下来的卡牌需要补齐，相比之下，《Riftbound》还可以只围绕当前轮换范围内的卡牌来开发。

paragraphs.en: Then there’s the elephant in the room…
paragraphs.cn: 此外，还有一个无法回避的问题……

paragraphs.en: Oh boy, this one stings. Legends of Runeterra was the first attempt at a League of Legends card game, and it’s solely a digital experience.
paragraphs.cn: 唉，说到这款游戏，实在让人心痛。《符文之地传说》是拳头首次尝试制作《英雄联盟》卡牌游戏的成果，而且只有数字版。

paragraphs.en: It launched in 2020, with Riftbound’s Dave Guskin working as one of its directors. The game is available on Windows, iOS, and Android, and is an excellent card battler that, in many ways, felt overly generous in handing out new cards.
paragraphs.cn: 该作于2020年上线，《Riftbound》的Dave Guskin曾担任其总监之一。游戏登陆了Windows、iOS和Android，是一款出色的卡牌对战游戏，而且在不少方面，它发放新卡牌时似乎慷慨得有些过头。

paragraphs.en: It’s still available, but updates have slowed to a crawl and now primarily focus on the Path of Champions - a sort of single-player roguelike mode.
paragraphs.cn: 这款游戏目前仍可游玩，但更新已经变得极其缓慢，如今主要围绕英雄之路（Path of Champions）展开。这是一种单人Roguelike模式。

paragraphs.en: Why do we bring it up? Because much of the card art and even the names from Legends of Runeterra cards made their way into Riftbound, despite the latter being built on entirely different mechanics.
paragraphs.cn: 为什么要提到它？因为《Riftbound》虽然采用了完全不同的机制，却沿用了《符文之地传说》中的许多卡牌插画，甚至连卡牌名称也一并采用。

paragraphs.en: If Riot leans into Riftbound as a digital TCG, it might be the final nail in the coffin of Legends of Runeterra - which would be very sad, especially given it’s sitting at an 87 on Metacritic .
paragraphs.cn: 如果拳头着力将《Riftbound》发展为数字集换式卡牌游戏，或许会给《符文之地传说》敲下最后一颗棺材钉。这会令人非常难过，尤其考虑到《符文之地传说》在Metacritic上有87分的成绩。
